title: aratama 'KAMI CIRCUIT 神回路' — vertical trailer

secondary_motion: glitch slicing, RGB split, strobe dropouts, datamosh/pixel-sort, manga speed-line bursts and screen shake; no springs or squash
color: saturated vermilion + black + white throughout, cyan as second accent, a blue/violet outro; limited palette but loud (colorfulness 39)
typography: kanji and Latin words fill the frame, sliced, extruded in 3D, glitched and split across cards (KA / MI / CIR / CUIT); manga SFX katakana
shape_language: precise HUD grids, circles and wireframes against organic fractal 3D architecture and hand-drawn manga speed lines
character_humor: no characters; manga onomatopoeia (ドンッ, ゴゴ) and a speech bubble give it a comic wink

signature: Vertical cyber-Shinto trailer: a slow HUD build (mandala push, torii tunnel, wireframe core) drops at 12.4 s into a 0.3–0.7 s card montage of sliced kanji, manga speed lines and fractal 3D, framed by a persistent HUD with timecode and BPM.

music.summary: 137 BPM electronic track (the HUD even prints '137.14 BPM'), clear pulse 0.61; the build is cut-free for ~28 beats, the montage starts on the beat at 12.4 s, then cuts follow the busy rhythm (dotted-eighth runs of 0.76 beat) rather than the quarter-note grid: overall cuts on beat 24% vs 32% chance.

family_note: High energy (7.7, cut-driven montage) and expressive tone (7.0) put it in the Playful reel zone, but the mood is epic/gritty, not playful. Proposed sub-style 'Cyber-HUD montage'; if more references like it arrive, the family name 'Playful reel' may need to become 'High-energy reel' or this becomes its own family. Two-part structure (flow build → cut-driven drop) is also notable.

behaviors.mechanism: a glowing vermilion ring around a kanji grows at constant rate while generative mandala rings fill in, until the frame is engulfed (scale / camera push through the mandala); occasional 1-frame strobe dropouts
behaviors.notes: Ring bbox height f62→f108 ≈ 351→1383 px at ~23 px/f; fit window f82–f105 rmse 0.002. Whole push lasts ~1.5 s (f62–f108); linear = continuous 'travel', no landing.

behaviors.mechanism: persistent HUD overlay in all scenes: corner brackets, title 'KAMI CIRCUIT 神回路 — 01', running timecode T+xx.xx, '137.14 BPM', chapter label (00 / IGNITION, 01 / SIGNAL, 02 / THRESHOLD, 03 / CORE...), audio-meter bars, dot grid
behaviors.notes: Read from z_hud_top/z_hud_bottom crops. Timecode and meter update every frame; acts as the continuity device across hard cuts.

behaviors.mechanism: after a red kanji title card fades to black, thin red horizontal/vertical scan lines sweep the frame and boot-log text lines type on one per ~3–6 f

a word is split across consecutive full-frame cards (KA / MI / CIR / CUIT), each card a different background (pink, vermilion, white, black) with the torii tunnel cut into a kanji or square mask; hard cut every 10 f
behaviors.notes: f372, f382, f392, f402: exactly 10 f apart = 0.76 beat at 136 BPM (dotted-eighth feel); the run starts on a beat (offset -0.05).

behaviors.mechanism: tomoe emblem slams in center with radial manga speed lines, katakana SFX (ドンッ, ゴゴ, ドッ) and an empty speech bubble; on each hit the frame inverts black/white/red for 1–2 f and the emblem squashes/rotates
behaviors.notes: Read from sheet e_ (f474–f524). Hits roughly every 8–16 f.

behaviors.mechanism: big kanji or Latin word (KAMI, CIRCUIT, SIGNAL, ALL, HUMAN, 神, 路) appears sliced into horizontal strips that are offset and snap into register over 2–6 f, with RGB split and texture mapped from the 3D scene
behaviors.notes: Read from sheets d_, g_ (f424–f440, f684–f734).

behaviors.mechanism: frame divided into a 4×6 grid of tiles (dials, waveforms, bars, hatching, wireframe cubes, red discs); tiles swap content independently every few frames; a kanji line (全人知覚) glitches across

two-part structure: 12.4 s cut-free build (slow pushes and orbits, motion 'Flow') then a drop on the beat into a cut-driven montage (~0.3–0.7 s shots, median 0.6 beat) until 24.8 s, then a calm outro and end card
behaviors.notes: From cuts.txt + librosa beat grid (beatgrid_ref09.py): first montage cut f372 lands -0.05 beat from a beat; later cuts spread around the grid.

behaviors.mechanism: outro: vertical Japanese line (神は回路に宿る) types on one character at a time over a dark violet nebula, a red target circle pulses; then 'END OF TRAILER' and the 璞 aratama logo (flash red → white → fade grey)
behaviors.notes: Read from sheet h_ (f746–f770, ~4 f per character); logo f842–f850.
